config.database.pdb.name: XEPDB1
config.//: Capture ONLY the two physically stored columns. The other 9 are virtual: LogMiner emits the text of their defining expression instead of a value, so without this they arrive as garbage on every update.
config.//lob: Required - XMLRECORD is XMLTYPE, stored as a hidden BLOB. Without this the XML never arrives.
config.//strategy: online_catalog reads the live data dictionary. The default (redo_log_catalog) dumps the dictionary into the redo stream and does not surface a change until its log is archived - on XE's two 10MB groups that means an idle table sits unmined indefinitely. Trade-off: online_catalog cannot track DDL changes to the captured table, which is fine for a fixed RECID/XMLRECORD shape.
